summary: Iteration 2: Verified Logs Activity feature + UI polish (Poppins font, rounded dialog, renamed sidebar labels, noindex meta). Backend pytest: 19/19 PASS (added 3 new /api/logs tests: auth-required, admin-only, schema of returned entries). Frontend Playwright: admin login lands on Dashboard; sidebar shows Dashboard, File Browser, List Storage, Manage User, Logs Activity (with correct data-testids nav-dashboard/nav-files/nav-storages/nav-users/nav-logs); /logs renders logs-table with empty-state 'No file activity recorded yet.' and refresh-logs-button; admin GET /api/logs -> 200 []; non-admin user does NOT see admin-only nav items, is redirected from /logs to /files, and gets 403 on GET /api/logs; noindex/nofollow meta present; body font-family = Poppins; Add Storage dialog opens with rounded style and all fields (bucket/region/endpoint/access_key/secret_key) render correctly. Cleanup of test user completed.

minor.issue: No pagination/limit param; capped at 500 entries returned with hard-coded to_list(500). Should expose limit/skip for large audit trails.
No filtering by user_email/action/storage_id/date-range - will be needed as logs grow.
No TTL/retention policy or index on timestamp - collection grows unbounded; queries will slow as it grows (add index on timestamp desc).
Failures inside insert_one are not caught - a Mongo hiccup during logging would 500 the parent upload/delete/create_folder request even after the file op succeeded.
POST /api/storages accepts empty config; DELETE returns 200 for unknown ids; malformed ObjectId in path -> 500; PUT allows type conversion; test_config has no timeout.

ui_bugs.issue: Refresh button uses a bordered variant that matches the page but there is no manual polling / live indicator - user must click Refresh to see new entries. Consider auto-refresh or WebSocket.

issues: Empty-state row is a subtle gray on black - readable but low visual weight; could add an icon for empty state.

action_items: (Optional) Add limit/skip + filters (user_email/action/storage_id/date range) to GET /api/logs, and create index on activity_logs.timestamp desc.
(Optional) Wrap log_activity() insert in try/except so logging failure never breaks the file operation.
Carry-over from iter1: strict Pydantic config validation on POST /api/storages, 404 on unknown storage/user delete, ObjectId format guard, reject type change on PUT, request timeout on test_config.
critical_code_review_comments: log_activity uses str(storage_doc['_id']) - fine; but activity_logs.timestamp is stored as ISO string, not BSON date. Sorting works lexicographically for ISO-8601 UTC but a datetime type would be safer for range queries.

GET /api/logs returns storage_type in the JSON but the returned dict comprehension currently includes it - confirmed present. However response schema is not modeled with Pydantic (raw dicts) so no automatic docs / validation.
Layout.jsx uses fixed w-64 sidebar + main ml-64 which is correct; content area now full-width. Verified via Playwright screenshots.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Non-admin test user created via API and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test user test_logs_ui_* created and deleted within the run. Admin intact. No storages persisted (regression add-storage flow filled dialog and dialog rendered correctly; submit-button data-testid differs from 'storage-submit-button' - button label is 'Add' - non-blocking test selector issue only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend stores JWT under localStorage key 'token' (NOT 'access_token'). Use localStorage.getItem('token') in evaluate() calls. Toaster now bottom-right (no overlap with Add buttons). New testids: nav-logs, logs-table, refresh-logs-button, log-row-{id}. Add Storage dialog submit button testid may not be 'storage-submit-button' (it renders text 'Add') - prefer role/name selector if needed. pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope so tests must be class-scoped and self-contained.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocker bugs. Feature works end-to-end.
